title: Adding a route to a product: what changes together
answers: What do I edit when adding a page route to a product?
Do I need to regenerate products.tsx after editing manifest?
What else changes when adding a backend endpoint?
body:
Frontend page: in `products/<name>/manifest.tsx` edit together: `routes` entry ['SceneName','sceneKey'], `scenes` entry (name must match tuple[0]; has lazy import), `urls` builder (path identical to route; use combineUrl), optional `redirects`, optional `treeItems*`. Then rerun `frontend/build-products.mjs` and commit regenerated products.tsx / productScenes.tsx / products.json. New icon/enum imports go into products.tsx by hand. Hyphenated routes hit semgrep rule `frontend-route-hyphen` (existing ones use nosemgrep).
Backend: viewset + register in routes.py; then `hogli build:openapi` to regenerate TS/MCP types.
Not verified: how the server serves SPA paths, or `frontend/bin/build-app-url-manifest.mjs`.
applies: Products with manifest.tsx; step ordering for treeItems assumes schema-general.ts types match.
